# 1.
```{r}
set.seed(123)
x <- rnorm(50)
B <- 1000
n <- length(x)
theta.hat <- median(x)
x.grand <- matrix(sample(x, B * n, replace = TRUE), nrow = B)
theta.grand <- mean(apply(x.grand, 1, median))
```

```{r}
# bias
bias <- theta.grand - median(x)
```

```{r}
# standard error
se <- sqrt(sum((apply(x.grand, 1, median)-theta.grand)^2)/(B-1))
se
```

```{r}
# standard normal bootstrap CI
theta.hat - bias + c(-qnorm(0.975), qnorm(0.975)) * se
```

```{r}
# basic bootstrap CI
theta.b <- apply(x.grand, 1, median)
2 * theta.hat - quantile(theta.b, c(0.975, 0.025))
```

```{r}
# bootstrap t-interval at 95%
se.b <- function(x) {
  n <- length(x)
  x.grand <- matrix(sample(x, B * n, replace = TRUE), nrow = B)
  theta.b <- apply(x.grand, 1, median)
  theta.grand <- mean(theta.b)
  return(sqrt(sum((theta.b - theta.grand)^2) / (B - 1)))
}
t.b <- (theta.b - theta.hat) / apply(x.grand, 1, se.b)
t.star <- sort(t.b)
theta.hat - quantile(t.star, c(0.975, 0.025)) * se
```
